string.text: Shortened variant of the Swiss-made assault rifle SIG SG-550, designed for special police forces. Unlike SG-550, the recoil spring rests against lower receiver instead of being wrapped around the gas piston rod. Like the base model, SG-552 is quite reliable and accurate, therefore popular with law enforcement agencies worldwide, like SWAT or British SAS.

Swiss-made SIG SG-552 assault rifle. Although hardly new, it is clear that the previous owner took good care of it: the weapon has been taken apart and put back together, with every component fine-tuned, increasing stopping power.
